This is an application under Section 439 Cr.P.C.
2.

The petitioner is an accused in connection with Bhawanipatna Sadar P.S. Case No.396 of 2023 corresponding to C.T. Case No.1020/105 of 2023 for the offences under Sections 363/366/376(2)(n)
of I.P.C. read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act pending in the Court of the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum- Special POCSO Judge, Kalahandi, Bhawanipatna.

entities.text: Additional Sessions Judge-cum- Special POCSO Judge, Kalahandi, Bhawanipatna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner, on instruction from the petitioner, submits that, except the present bail application, no other bail application of the petitioner is pending in any other Court relating to the aforesaid F.I.R.
4.
The prosecution story in brief is that on 12.10.2023, the informant lodged an F.I.R. alleging therein that his daughter aged about 16 years was missing from the night of 11.10.2023.

The accused-petitioner and the victim girl were studying in same college and were going to college every day, therefore the petitioner was suspected to have the role in the disappearance of the victim.
Out of suspicion, the informant lodged the F.I.R. against the petitioner.
5. The statement of the victim, who is stated to be 16 years old, has been recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
She in her statement inter alia stated that she was in relationship with the petitioner.
She had gone with the petitioner to different places.
Eventually they landed at Bhawanipatna and stayed together for a month.
On 07.12.2023, she called up her mother and thereafter she was rescued.
Subsequent thereto, the F.I.R. was registered.
The petitioner is 19 years old and he is in custody since 09.12.2023.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioner had approached the learned Additional Sessions Judge-cum-Special Court under POCSO Act, Bhawanipatna in C.T. Case No.1020/105 of 2023 praying for grant of bail.
The learned Court below vide its order dated 07.02.2024 has rejected the bail application of the petitioner.
Being aggrieved, the petitioner has filed the present petition under Section 439 Cr.P.C. praying for enlargement on bail.
7. Regard being had to the period of custody from 09.12.2023, the nature of accusation and the age of the petitioner, I am inclined to admit the petitioners on bail.

Hence, the petitioner directed to be released on bail by the Court in seisin over the matter in the aforesaid case on such terms and conditions as it would deem just and proper, subject to the following additional conditions:-
(i) The petitioner shall appear before the trial Court on each date on which the case is posted for trial.
(ii) He shall not tamper with the evidence in any manner whatsoever.
(iii) He shall not keep in contact with the victim or her family members in any manner whatsoever.
Violation of any of the conditions shall entail consideration for cancellation of the bail granted to the petitioner.
In the event, any of the bail conditions are violated by the petitioners, the prosecution is given liberty to move appropriate application before the Court below for recalling the concession of bail.
If such application is moved, the trial Court should decide the application on its own merit.
8. The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.

(S.S. Mishra) Judge Swarna Location: High Court of Orissa Bikash Nial vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party(S) on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/184159972/
